# KiTTY++

> KiTTY++ is an SSH and Telnet client suite for Windows on a PuTTY 0.85 core: kitty.exe (terminal), klink (command-line SSH), kscp and ksftp (file transfer), kageant (SSH agent), kittygen (key generator).

AI agents start with docs/AGENTS-GUIDE.md: one self-contained block per task, with the command, the expected result, the failure signs and what an AI agent must never do. Downloads only from https://github.com/hknet/KiTTY/releases.

## Docs

- [KiTTY++ for AI agents](https://github.com/hknet/KiTTY/blob/kitty-0.85/docs/AGENTS-GUIDE.md): tasks for AI agents plus a safe workspace setup for the human in charge
- [README](https://github.com/hknet/KiTTY/blob/kitty-0.85/README.md): downloads, installers, signatures, checksums
- [Features](https://github.com/hknet/KiTTY/blob/kitty-0.85/FEATURES.md): every feature with how to enable it
- [kitty.ini](https://github.com/hknet/KiTTY/blob/kitty-0.85/docs/KITTY-INI.md): the settings file, its sections and the store rules
- [Windows Event Log](https://github.com/hknet/KiTTY/blob/kitty-0.85/docs/WINDOWS-EVENT-LOG.md): the logs, sources, read access and forwarding
- [Event IDs](https://github.com/hknet/KiTTY/blob/kitty-0.85/docs/EVENT-IDS.md): every event ID with its fields

## Optional

- [SSH certificates](https://github.com/hknet/KiTTY/blob/kitty-0.85/docs/SSH-CERTIFICATES.md): user and host certificates, KiTTY++ and OpenSSH side
- [kageant protocol extensions](https://github.com/hknet/KiTTY/blob/kitty-0.85/docs/PROTOCOL-AGENT-KAPPER.md): withheld-keys-v00@kapper.net and session-bind-host-v00@kapper.net, their wire format and security notes
- [Changelog](https://github.com/hknet/KiTTY/blob/kitty-0.85/CHANGELOG.md): changes per release
